Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misapplication of Wien's Displacement Law regarding the order of colors by temperature. The Planner correctly identified that blue light corresponds to the highest temperature and red to the lowest, but incorrectly placed orange (Object 3) as hotter than red (Object 2). In the visible spectrum, orange light has a longer wavelength (lower energy) than red light, meaning orange objects are cooler than red objects. Consequently, the Planner generated the sequence Blue > Red > Orange (Object 1, Object 2, Object 3) instead of the correct sequence Blue > Orange > Red (Object 1, Object 3, Object 2).
